title: LLM Atlas: Priority Map and Supplier Traction Study
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Purpose: Produce a data-driven, prioritized map of open and vendor LLMs that matter for Redwood customers across latency, cost, inference compatibility, and commercial availability. Deliverables: (1) Executive one-pager with top 12 models across three buyer personas (Startups, Mid-market SaaS, Regulated Enterprise), (2) Regional availability and procurement friction table, (3) Supplier traction dashboard prototype, (4) Recommendation set for onboarding candidates for benchmarking and Dedicated procurement pilots. Scope: public models, prominent commercial variants, and pre-release signals. Methods: telemetry + public repo scraping, partner procurement interviews, API latency sampling across regions, cost-per-token normalized to Redwood serving assumptions, and qualitative scoring for enterprise compliance risk.
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with Research, Eng (model-ops), and Solutions. Agreed on success metrics: #models prioritized, regional availability coverage, and a supplier traction score combining commits, community forks, and commercial partner mentions.

2026-03-04: Pipeline POC complete — automated ingest of model metadata from Hugging Face model-index, provider release notes, and GitHub stars. Initial ingest covered ~230 models. Notebook: models_ingest_v0.ipynb linked in artifacts.

2026-03-06: Trade-off decided: exclude tiny (<100M param) models from priority list unless they show distinct latency/cost advantage for embeddings workloads. Rationale: limited product impact for text-generation roadmap.

2026-03-07: Security sync: confirmed we can store public metadata and telemetry samples; any vendor-provided procurement documents will be handled in the Private Docs vault. Security requested a gating checklist for adding vendor-provided artifacts.

2026-03-10: PM design review — early draft of the priority map visual accepted with feedback to surface fallbacks and quantized variant compatibility. Action: Design to iterate on legend and persona filters (DES assigned: Nora Patel).

2026-03-11: Data gap identified: APAC availability for several Chinese-hosted models inconsistent. Outreach plan drafted for partners and cloud marketplaces to validate region availability. Assigned to Liam.

2026-03-12: Scope update: prioritize top 40 models for deep benchmarking (latency/cost/quality) and produce supplier traction scores for all ingested models. Added an explicit deliverable: procurement friction index for Dedicated contracts.
notes: This work will feed Redwood Optimize recommendations and Dedicated procurement prioritization. Coordinate with Growth for any externalized publishing cadence. Avoid public naming of models that are under NDA until legal clears the summary.
